# Environment variables

<!-- Generated by sdk/python/tests/_reference_docs.py; a test keeps it equal. -->

The `FABRIC_*` variables the SDKs and the CLI read. `fabric run` sets the ones an
agent needs from fabric.yaml; a variable already set in the shell wins over
fabric.yaml. Keys and tokens are passed by file (`*_FILE`), never by value, on the
default path. Fabric never sets or changes an `OTEL_*` variable. Python only
unless marked TS or Python and TS.

## Identity

| Variable | What it does |
|---|---|
| `FABRIC_TENANT_ID` | The tenant every record belongs to (fabric.yaml `tenant`). |
| `FABRIC_AGENT_ID` | The agent's id (fabric.yaml `agent`). |
| `FABRIC_AGENT_NAME` | The agent's display name on decision records. |
| `FABRIC_AGENT_VERSION` | The agent's version on decision records. |
| `FABRIC_PROFILE` | The recorder profile of the explicit APIs (`local`, `shadow`, `production`). |
| `FABRIC_WORKFLOW_ID` | A workflow id stamped on decision records. |
| `FABRIC_EXECUTION_ID` | An execution id stamped on decision records. |
| `FABRIC_SYSTEM_ID` | The system id on wire capture records. |
| `FABRIC_DEPLOYMENT_ID` | The deployment id on wire capture records. |
| `FABRIC_RELEASE_ID` | The release id on wire capture records. |
| `FABRIC_ENVIRONMENT` | The environment name on wire capture records. |
| `FABRIC_SOURCE_ID` | The capture source id (default: derived per process). |
| `FABRIC_HOST_LABEL` | A label for the host on hook records (the injector sets the node name). |
| `FABRIC_IDENTITY_MODE` | `pseudonymous` (default) or `clear`: how caller ids are recorded. |
| `FABRIC_ALLOW_PLACEHOLDER_IDS` | Accept placeholder ids (tests and examples only). |
| `FABRIC_QUIET_PII_WARN` | `1` silences the warning about identifier fields that look like personal data. |

## Runs

| Variable | What it does |
|---|---|
| `FABRIC_RUN_ID` | The run label (`fabric run` sets a fresh one, or `--run NAME`). |
| `FABRIC_RUN_RESUME_TOKEN` | Resumes a run in another process (from `fabric.wire.run()`). |
| `FABRIC_RUN_OPEN_DEADLINE_S` | How long an unclosed run stays open before it is sealed. |
| `FABRIC_CLOCK_UNCERTAINTY_MS` | The clock uncertainty this process declares (default 1 s). |
| `FABRIC_RECORDS_STRICT` | `1`: strict test mode of the records API (raises instead of recording a loss). |
| `FABRIC_RECORDS_MAX_OBJECT_BYTES` | Size cap of one records-input content object (default and maximum 16 MiB). |

## Delivery

| Variable | What it does |
|---|---|
| `FABRIC_OTLP_ENDPOINT` | The Fabric Node's base URL; when any FABRIC_OTLP_* is set, no OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_* is read (Python and TS). |
| `FABRIC_OTLP_CERTIFICATE` | The CA file the Node's certificate is checked with (Python and TS). |
| `FABRIC_OTLP_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE` | A client certificate file for the Node (Python and TS). |
| `FABRIC_OTLP_CLIENT_KEY` | Its private key file (Python and TS). |
| `FABRIC_OTLP_HEADERS_FILE` | A file of `k=v` headers: the ingest token (Python and TS). |
| `FABRIC_WIRE_CONTENT_ENDPOINT` | The Node's content endpoint when the store is `node`. |
| `FABRIC_WIRE_PROXY` | An explicit CONNECT proxy for Fabric's own delivery. |
| `FABRIC_WIRE_TRACER` | `private` (default) or `global`: the tracer provider wire capture uses. |
| `FABRIC_WIRE_STATUS_FILE` | A path the SDK writes its capture status to at install and exit (`fabric run` sets it). |
| `FABRIC_WIRE_DIAGNOSTICS` | `stderr`: print capture diagnostics on stderr (Python and TS). |
| `FABRIC_OTEL_DIAGNOSTICS` | `stderr`: print Fabric's own exporter diagnostics on stderr. |

## Wire capture

| Variable | What it does |
|---|---|
| `FABRIC_WIRE_AUTOLOAD` | `1`: install wire capture at interpreter start (`fabric run` sets it). |
| `FABRIC_WIRE_ENDPOINTS` | Extra model endpoints as JSON matchers (fabric.yaml `providers.custom`). |
| `FABRIC_WIRE_BUILTIN_ENDPOINTS` | `legacy` pins the first three built-in endpoint rows. |
| `FABRIC_WIRE_AIOHTTP` | `0` turns off the aiohttp tee (default on). |
| `FABRIC_WIRE_MODEL_ALLOWLIST` | Model names reported as is; others appear as digests. |
| `FABRIC_WIRE_PROVIDER_REQUEST_ID` | `1` records the provider's request id header (default off). |
| `FABRIC_WIRE_LABELS` | `clear`: operator labels exported unchanged (default: keyed labels). |
| `FABRIC_CAPTURE_LLM_CONTENT` | Explicit APIs only; it does not affect wire capture. |
| `FABRIC_CONTENT_MODE` | `metadata`: the explicit APIs record no content. |

## Hooks

| Variable | What it does |
|---|---|
| `FABRIC_WIRE_EXEC` | `1`: record the commands the agent runs (fabric.yaml `capture.exec`). |
| `FABRIC_WIRE_HTTP_HOSTS` | Non-model hosts whose requests are recorded (fabric.yaml `capture.http_hosts`). |
| `FABRIC_WIRE_MCP` | `1`: record MCP messages (fabric.yaml `capture.mcp`). |
| `FABRIC_WIRE_REMOTE_SANDBOX` | `e2b`: record commands sent to an E2B sandbox. |
| `FABRIC_WIRE_SANDBOX_HOSTS` | Hosts of other sandbox providers, so a gap is named. |
| `FABRIC_WIRE_EXEC_AUDIT` | Reserved for a hook not built in this release. |
| `FABRIC_WIRE_FILE_AUDIT` | Reserved for a hook not built in this release. |
| `FABRIC_WIRE_DB_DRIVERS` | Reserved for a hook not built in this release. |

## Keys and privacy

| Variable | What it does |
|---|---|
| `FABRIC_WIRE_ID_KEY` | The pseudonym id key, by value (prefer the _FILE form). |
| `FABRIC_WIRE_ID_KEY_FILE` | The file holding the id key (`fabric run` sets it; Python and TS). |
| `FABRIC_TOKENIZATION_KEY` | The tokenization key of `tokenize` roles (at least 32 bytes; or its _FILE form). |
| `FABRIC_CAPTURE_POLICY` | The capture policy file (fabric.yaml `capture.privacy`). |
| `FABRIC_REDACTION_ENDPOINT` | A redaction service socket for `redact` roles (Python and TS). |
| `FABRIC_REDACTION_TOKEN_FILE` | Its token file (Python and TS). |

## Spool and store

| Variable | What it does |
|---|---|
| `FABRIC_WIRE_SPOOL_DIR` | Where the spool lives; `off` in local file mode exports directly. |
| `FABRIC_WIRE_SPOOL_KEY` | The spool encryption key (or its _FILE form). |
| `FABRIC_WIRE_SPOOL_MAX_BYTES` | The spool's bound; over it the SDK records a loss and never blocks. |
| `FABRIC_WIRE_SPOOL_DURABLE_BOUNDARY` | The spool directory or an ancestor that must be durable storage. |
| `FABRIC_WIRE_SPOOL_MIGRATE_PLAINTEXT` | Migrate a plaintext spool to encrypted (local profile only). |
| `FABRIC_WIRE_DRAIN_ON_EXIT_S` | How long the SDK drains the spool at process exit. |
| `FABRIC_WIRE_STORE` | The content store: `node`, or `file:///dir` for a local trial. |
| `FABRIC_WIRE_STORE_SSE` | Refused in the agent: encryption is configured on the Node. |
| `FABRIC_WIRE_STORE_KMS_KEY_ID` | Refused in the agent: encryption is configured on the Node. |

## The CLI

| Variable | What it does |
|---|---|
| `FABRIC_CONFIG` | The fabric.yaml to use (after `--config`). |
| `FABRIC_CHART` | The chart `fabric up --kubernetes` installs (default: the release's). |
| `FABRIC_NODE_IMAGE` | The Node image `fabric up` runs (default: pinned by digest). |
| `FABRIC_SENSOR_IMAGE` | The sensor image `fabric up` runs (default: pinned by digest). |
| `FABRIC_SINK_IMAGE` | The local destination image `fabric up` runs (default: pinned by digest). |
| `FABRIC_CLI_IMAGE` | TS: the image `npx fabric` runs the full CLI from (default: the release's). |

`FABRIC_TOKENIZATION_KEY_FILE` and `FABRIC_WIRE_SPOOL_KEY_FILE` are the file
forms of their keys.
